metadata.description: List of authors of the AI Safety Atlas in landing page.

content.name: Markov Grey
content.description: Primary author and project developer. Contributes across all aspects - research, writing, distillation, website development, video creation. Previously scriptwriter at Rational Animations, distillation fellow at AI Safety Info (Stampy). Also currently co-founder and CTO at Equilibria Network. In a previous life has also worked in software development and cybersecurity.

content.name: Charbel-Raphaël Segerie
content.description: Executive Director of CeSIA. Leads organization, scientific direction and coordination. Significant pedagogical experience including ARENA projects, MLAB, and Europe's first general purpose AI safety course. Writing featured in BlueDot's interpretability curriculum.

content.name: Jeanne Salle
content.description: AI safety teacher at ENS Ulm. Contributing author.

content.name: Charles Martinet
content.description: Head of policy at CeSIA, research affiliate at Oxford AIGi and previously at GovAI. Contributing author.
